Module 1.title: First Order Ordinary Differential Equations and Applications
Module 1.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary: First Order ODEs
  • Exact Differential Equation: $M dx + N dy = 0$ is exact if $\frac{\partial M}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial N}{\partial x}$. Solution: $\int_{y=C} M dx + \int (\text{terms in } N \text{ free of } x) dy = C$.
  • Integrating Factors (IF):
    • If $\frac{1}{N}(M_y - N_x) = f(x)$, $IF = e^{\int f(x) dx}$.
    • Linear ODE $\frac{dy}{dx} + P(x) y = Q(x) \implies IF = e^{\int P dx}$, solution: $y \cdot IF = \int Q \cdot IF dx + C$.
    • Bernoulli ODE: $\frac{dy}{dx} + P y = Q y^n \implies$ divide by $y^n$, substitute $v = y^{1-n}$.
  • Orthogonal Trajectories: Replace $\frac{dy}{dx}$ with $-\frac{dx}{dy}$. In polar: replace $\frac{dr}{d\theta}$ with $-r^2 \frac{d\theta}{dr}$.
Module 1.detailed_notes:
Module 1 Reference: First Order ODEs

Newton's Law of Cooling: $\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_a) \implies T(t) = T_a + (T_0 - T_a)e^{-kt}$.

Module 2.title: Higher Order Linear Differential Equations with Constant Coefficients
Module 2.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary: Higher Order Linear ODEs
  • General Solution: $y = y_c + y_p$ (Complementary Function + Particular Integral).
  • Complementary Function (Auxiliary Equation $f(m) = 0$):
    • Real distinct roots: $y_c = C_1 e^{m_1 x} + C_2 e^{m_2 x}$.
    • Real repeated roots: $y_c = (C_1 + C_2 x) e^{m x}$.
    • Complex conjugate roots $\alpha \pm i \beta$: $y_c = e^{\alpha x} (C_1 \cos \beta x + C_2 \sin \beta x)$.
  • Method of Variation of Parameters: $y_p = -y_1 \int \frac{y_2 X}{W} dx + y_2 \int \frac{y_1 X}{W} dx$, where Wronskian $W = y_1 y_2' - y_2 y_1'$.
  • Cauchy-Euler Equidimensional Equation: $x^2 y'' + a x y' + b y = f(x) \implies$ Substitute $x = e^z$ ($z = \ln x$).
Module 2.detailed_notes:
Module 2 Reference: Second Order ODEs

Harmonic oscillator equation $m \ddot{x} + c \dot{x} + k x = F(t)$ solved via characteristic polynomials.

Module 3.title: Laplace Transforms, Inverse Transforms and Convolution
Module 3.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary: Laplace Transforms
  • Standard Transforms: $\mathcal{L}\{1\} = 1/s$, $\mathcal{L}\{e^{at}\} = \frac{1}{s-a}$, $\mathcal{L}\{\sin \omega t\} = \frac{\omega}{s^2 + \omega^2}$, $\mathcal{L}\{\cos \omega t\} = \frac{s}{s^2 + \omega^2}$, $\mathcal{L}\{t^n\} = \frac{n!}{s^{n+1}}$.
  • First Shifting Theorem: $\mathcal{L}\{e^{at} f(t)\} = F(s - a)$.
  • Derivative Transform: $\mathcal{L}\{f'(t)\} = s F(s) - f(0)$, $\mathcal{L}\{f''(t)\} = s^2 F(s) - s f(0) - f'(0)$.
  • Convolution Theorem: $\mathcal{L}^{-1}\{F(s) G(s)\} = f(t) * g(t) = \int_0^t f(u) g(t - u) du$.
  • Dirac Delta & Heaviside Step: $\mathcal{L}\{u(t - a)\} = \frac{e^{-as}}{s}$, $\mathcal{L}\{\delta(t - a)\} = e^{-as}$.
Module 3.detailed_notes:
Module 3 Reference: Laplace Transforms

Transforms time-domain differential equations into algebraic equations in complex frequency variable $s$.

Module 4.title: Fourier Series and Harmonic Analysis
Module 4.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary: Fourier Series
  • Fourier Expansion in $[-\pi, \pi]$: $f(x) = \frac{a_0}{2} + \sum_{n=1}^\infty [a_n \cos nx + b_n \sin nx]$. $$a_0 = \frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^\pi f(x)dx, \quad a_n = \frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^\pi f(x)\cos nx dx, \quad b_n = \frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^\pi f(x)\sin nx dx$$
  • Even & Odd Functions:
    • Even function ($f(-x) = f(x)$): $b_n = 0$ (Cosine series only).
    • Odd function ($f(-x) = -f(x)$): $a_0 = a_n = 0$ (Sine series only).
  • Half-Range Expansions in $[0, L]$: Half-range cosine series ($b_n = 0$), half-range sine series ($a_n = 0$).
Module 4.detailed_notes:
Module 4 Reference: Fourier Series

Dirichlet's conditions ensure convergence of Fourier series to $\frac{f(x^+) + f(x^-)}{2}$ at jump discontinuities.
Module 4.textbook_html:
4.1 Periodic Signals and Harmonic Decomposition

Module 5.title: Partial Differential Equations and Separation of Variables
Module 5.short_notes:
⚡ High-Yield Exam Summary: PDEs in Engineering
  • 1D Wave Equation (Vibrating String): $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial t^2} = c^2 \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$. Solution via separation of variables: $u(x,t) = \sum_{n=1}^\infty B_n \sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right) \cos\left(\frac{n\pi c t}{L}\right)$.
  • 1D Heat Conduction Equation: $\frac{\partial u}{\partial t} = \alpha \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}$. Solution: $u(x,t) = \sum_{n=1}^\infty A_n \sin\left(\frac{n\pi x}{L}\right) e^{-\alpha (\frac{n\pi}{L})^2 t}$.
  • 2D Laplace Equation (Steady State Temp): $\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0$.
Module 5.detailed_notes:
Module 5 Reference: PDEs

Boundary value problems solved by separation of variables: $u(x,t) = X(x) T(t)$ matching physical Dirichlet/Neumann conditions.
